app.name: New Unlock Screen
cli.about: Create unlock screens (the one asking for the disk password at boot) with your own drawing. Pick them in Style → Unlock.
cli.editar: open this screen to edit it (its folder name)
vista.vacia: Pick a drawing to see how the screen will look.
vista.fallo: The drawing can't be read. Pick another image (PNG, JPG or WebP).
estado.guardada: Saved · pick it in Style → Unlock or press a
archivos.elige: Highlight an image to see it.
borrar.detalle: Its folder is deleted. If it is set at boot, it stays until you pick another one in Style → Unlock.
aviso.sin_guardar: Unsaved changes: s to save them or repeat to discard them
aviso.salir_sin_guardar: Unsaved changes: s to save them or q again to quit
aviso.duplicada: Copy ready: change anything and save it with s
aviso.guardada: Saved. It now shows up in Style → Unlock
aviso.sandbox: Test mode: the boot screen is not changed
aviso.aplicada: Done: you'll see it next time you turn on the computer
aviso.error_aplicar: Couldn't set it at boot. Check the terminal message
aviso.cancelado: Cancelled: the boot screen didn't change
aviso.ruta_invalida: That path is not a folder or an image (PNG, JPG or WebP)
cabecera.prueba: Test mode: the boot screen is not touched
